defs.def: a container with a spout, a handle and a lid, used for making and serving tea 茶壶

ex.s: I didn't think about it much until a morning last week when I knocked my favorite teapot off the table.
ex.t: 我没太在意这件事，直到上周一个早晨，我把最心爱的茶壶从桌上碰掉了。

ex.s: Samovar—the Special Teapot Hello, my speech today is about a very special teapot— the samovar!
ex.t: 俄式茶壶——特别的茶壶。大家好，我今天的演讲是关于一个非常特别的茶壶——俄式茶壶！

ex.s: First, a teapot containing lots of tea leaves and a little water is placed on top of the samovar.
ex.t: 首先，在萨莫瓦山顶放置一个茶壶，内含大量的茶叶和一点水。

ex.s: As the samovar heats up, the teapot begins to produce a strong tea concentrate.
ex.t: 当茶壶加热时，茶壶开始产生浓郁的茶浓缩物。

chunks.cn: 热 上 该 茶壶
